result.citation: San Diego Mun. Code § 98.0704 (Ord. O-21647 N.S., as amended through Ord. O-21769 N.S.); see also id. §§ 98.0704(a), (b), 98.0706(b)(1), (e)
result.official_quote: A landlord shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause. For purposes of this Division, just cause includes at-fault just cause and no-fault just cause.
result.note: Changed 'amended by' to 'as amended through Ord. O-21769 N.S.' per the § 98.0704 history note in D073 and added see-also cites to the at-fault and no-fault cause lists (§ 98.0704(a), (b)), the 30/60-day notice rule (§ 98.0706(b)(1)) and the void-notice rule (§ 98.0706(e)) that the card also states; the card's quote stays, taken from D073, the official code text in the supplied corpus.
